latest_release.body:
Release 2026-11-06 23:04

## Changes

### Features

- vue-query: return a reactive `state` from `useQuery` so `status=== 'success'` narrows `data` without unwrapping refs (#12541) (f4199ab51) by @DamianOsipiuk

### Fix

- vue-query: keep query-core's `enabled(query)` callback (#12542) (025773a83) by @DamianOsipiuk
